title: Traffic Signs
summary: Duckling, Chick and Piglet ride with Mother Hen to a soccer game, and on the way they learn what the traffic light and the road signs say. Will they get there on time?
pages: Three friends, Duckling, Chick and Piglet, are going to watch a soccer game.
The game will start at ten o'clock in the morning.
At half past nine, Mother Hen started the car. The three friends jumped into the car of Chick and his mother.

Mother Hen said, "Everyone buckle your seat belts, please!"
Then Mother Hen started to drive.

After driving a little while, Mother Hen stopped the car.
Chick asked, "Mom! Mom! Why did you stop? Won't we be late?"
Mother Hen answered, "Oh! That's a red light. We have to stop and wait for the green light, and only then can we drive!"
Chick kept asking, "Why do we have to do what the traffic light says?"

Mother Hen answered, "To keep ourselves safe!"
When the light changed to green, Mother Hen drove on.

Chick asked, "Mom! Why are you stopping again?"
"Oh! This is a crosswalk. Look at the sign over there, on the right!"

"We have to stop and let people cross the road, and only after that can we drive!"
After the people crossed the road, Mother Hen drove on.

"Mother Hen! Why do we have to stop again?"
asked Piglet.
"Oh! There's a roundabout ahead. We have to wait for the cars coming from the right to go first."

When the cars coming from the right had passed, Mother Hen drove on.
Chick said, "Mom! Mom! Hurry!
Let's just park here!" Mother Hen answered, "We can't! Do you see that sign? No parking here."

Chick asked, "And can we park here?
We've reached the parking lot, and there's a parking sign!"
The three friends were happy they arrived on time.

They showed their tickets before they went into the stadium.
"Hurry! Hurry! The game is about to start!"

Piglet said, "Yay! We got here just in time!"
Everyone watched the game and had lots of fun.
